name: Sheraton Lake Como Hotel
positioning: Resort set in a private park near Lake Como, a few steps from the boat pier and a 10-minute walk from Cernobbio
best_for: Families wanting a park with a pool, solarium and kids' playground
Couples wanting a large spa and a suite with a private terrace

facts.text: The resort is set in a private park with a swimming pool, solarium and whirlpool area.
The park covers over 11,000 square meters of lush green lawns, for sunbathing, jogging or a picnic on the grass.
The hotel is a few steps from the boat pier.
Cernobbio is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
Room windows look out over the private park and pool and the surrounding mountains.
All rooms are decorated with Made in Italy furniture and have Sheraton signature beds.
The suites have a private terrace with sun loungers and a coffee table.
The Junior Suite marble bathroom has a double basin, a tub and a separate shower with chromotherapy.
The spa covers over 700 square meters, with treatment rooms, a nail studio and a wet area with an indoor pool, hydropool, sauna, Mediterranean bath, emotional showers and an ice waterfall.
Spa rituals are developed with the Italian dermocosmetics brand INSIUM.
Kitchen is the hotel's Michelin-starred restaurant and opens onto the park.
The park has a kids' playground with wooden play equipment.

highlights.text: The resort is set in a private park with a swimming pool, solarium and whirlpool area.
The spa covers over 700 square meters, with treatment rooms, a nail studio and a wet area with an indoor pool, hydropool, sauna, Mediterranean bath, emotional showers and an ice waterfall.
The spa's Private Suite Experience pairs a couple's massage with exclusive use of the wet area after closing, with fine bubbles and gourmet treats.
The Junior Suites open onto the private pool and park.
Room windows look out over the private park and pool and the surrounding mountains.

considerations.text: Como city centre is 10 minutes away by car or by the traditional battello boat.
Spa entry is complimentary for all hotel guests, with reservation required.
WhataHotel notes it may lack the intimate boutique charm of smaller lake properties.
